title: Resolution condemning Supreme Court ruling ending TPS for Haitians and Syrians
summary: This resolution condemns the U.S. Supreme Court's June 25, 2026 decision in Mullin v. Doe, which allowed the federal government to end Temporary Protected Status for Haitian and Syrian nationals. It cites over 180,000 Haitians living in New York, mostly in Brooklyn, and roughly 7 percent of Syrian immigrants residing in New York, who could lose deportation protections and work authorization. The Council states these TPS holders may face deportation to countries the State Department rates as unsafe for travel.
